purpose: Distinguish a canonical DAE partition-choice defect from a genuine reduced-background/reduced-matter constraint incompatibility. Repair08 proved that the initial surface closes, the physical matter sign is correct, the full-standard CLASS momentum closes the GE15 shift equation, and the violation appears only under reduced evolution.
permitted_operations: reuse the frozen Repair07 stable GE06 and GE07 local linear maps byte-for-byte
reuse the frozen Repair07 initial state, Radau-IIA coefficients, grids, modes, C values and initial dynamic match
replace only the sixth canonical algebraic row from anisotropy to shift in a separate diagnostic implementation
monitor anisotropy with the same componentwise backward-error metric used by Repair07
report local algebraic condition numbers, Radau residuals, lapse residuals, shift residuals, anisotropy residuals and Nt64/Nt32 convergence
compare the alternate trajectory to the historical Repair07 trajectory diagnostically

routing_logic.DAE_PARTITION_DEFECT_LOCALIZED: alternate shift-enforced partition has both shift and anisotropy <=1e-6, linear residual <=1e-8, Nt64/Nt32 state convergence <=5e-3, initial match <=1e-10 and finite outputs
routing_logic.REDUCED_BACKGROUND_CONSTRAINT_INCOMPATIB: alternate shift row is solved accurately but the independent anisotropy monitor exceeds 1e-6 while numerical controls remain otherwise healthy
routing_logic.ALTERNATE_PARTITION_NUMERICAL_FAIL: alternate algebraic block is singular/ill-conditioned to the point of failed solve, nonfinite output, linear residual failure or time-grid failure
routing_logic.DUAL_PARTITION_RESULT_AMBIGUOUS: none of the predeclared routing conditions applies cleanly

claim_boundary: Diagnostic reduced-H1 audit only. No H3/Z20, finite eta, finite physical-amplitude nonlinear evolution, collapse, lensing or observational claim is licensed.
